description: This Java interface defines configuration methods for background streaming behavior in a system, including enabling/disabling streaming, setting quiet periods, managing kept events, and retrieving configuration in HOCON format.

classes.name: BackgroundStreamingConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuration settings related to background streaming, including enabling status, quiet period duration, number of kept events, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if background streaming is enabled.

methods.name: getQuietPeriod
methods.description: Provides the duration to wait between streams.

methods.name: getKeptEvents
methods.description: Returns the number of events maintained in the actor state.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration in HOCON format.
